meta.title: Gym in Sunny Beach — Fitness Plamen GYM | Open 09:00–21:00
meta.description: Old-school iron gym in the centre of Sunny Beach. Dumbbells up to 55 kg, a calisthenics park, a boxing area and air conditioning. Day, week and month passes — call or walk in.

hero.imageAlt: The entrance to Fitness Plamen GYM, marked by a hand-painted mural

proofBar.claim: The Best Gym In Sunny Beach — And The Numbers Prove It

theGym.paragraph1: Plamen, the owner, built most of the machines here with his own hands. Not because he couldn't buy new ones — he knows exactly how each one needs to work.
theGym.paragraph2: 23 years on, the iron here still isn't shiny or new — we keep it maintained and fully working, because that's the point of old school: a tool that does the job every day, not a showroom.

items.question: Is there a gym in Sunny Beach?
items.answer: Yes, Fitness Plamen GYM is in the centre of Sunny Beach. It's an old-school iron gym with barbells, dumbbells and owner-built machines, open every day from 09:00 to 21:00.

items.question: Do you sell day passes?
items.answer: Yes, day, week and month passes are all available. Call the number below or come by in person — we'll walk you through the passes on the spot, no booking or paperwork needed.

items.question: What are the opening hours?
items.answer: Fitness Plamen GYM is open every day from 09:00 to 21:00, with no closing day. You can walk in at any point during those hours.

items.question: Where exactly is the gym?
items.answer: The gym is in the centre (Tsentar) of Sunny Beach, a few minutes' walk from the beach. Open the address directly in Google Maps via the "Find us" link on this page for exact directions.

items.question: When is the gym least busy?
items.answer: Mornings tend to be quieter than the busier evening hours, when most guests come in after the beach. If you'd rather have more space around the machines, try coming earlier in the day.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.authorityNote: The Bulgarian version of this policy is the legally authoritative one. This English version is provided for convenience — if the two differ, the Bulgarian text governs.
privacy.s1Body: The data controller is the company operating Fitness Plamen GYM, listed below.
privacy.s2Intro: We collect very little — only what the site actually needs to run:
privacy.s2Log: Server log data: IP address, browser user agent, requested URL and timestamp. Collected automatically by our hosting provider.
privacy.s2Cookie: Language preference, stored in a cookie named NEXT_LOCALE.
privacy.s2None: Nothing else. We have no contact form, no account system, no newsletter, and no advertising or analytics trackers.
privacy.s2Phone: If you call us, we keep no recording and no written record of the call.
privacy.s3Heading: Why we process it, and on what legal basis
privacy.s3LogsBody: Processed under legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR): site security, abuse prevention, and diagnosing faults.
privacy.s3CookieBody: Strictly necessary for a service you've requested (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) — that's why we don't ask for consent.
privacy.s4Body: Our hosting provider retains server logs for a short period and then deletes them. The exact retention period is still being confirmed with the host — TODO_OWNER.
privacy.s5Body: We share data only with our hosting provider, Vercel Inc., acting as a processor on our instructions. Data may be processed outside the EEA under an EU adequacy decision or Standard Contractual Clauses. We never sell data, and we never share it with advertisers.
s6Rights: lodge a complaint with the Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection (КЗЛД), www.cpdp.bg, Sofia
privacy.s6Contact: To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details above.
privacy.s6ResponseTime: We respond within one month, as required by GDPR.
privacy.s7Body: This site is not directed at children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect their data.
privacy.s8Body: This site links to Google Maps and Facebook. Once you follow them, their own privacy policies apply — not ours.
privacy.s9Body: If this policy changes, we publish the updated version here with a new "last updated" date above.
privacy.cookieNote: We use no analytics, advertising or third-party tracking cookies — that's why we don't ask for cookie consent.
privacy.cookieClear: You can clear this cookie in your browser settings at any time — the site will still work, it will just forget your language choice.

terms.heading: Terms of Use
terms.intro: This site is informational only. No bookings or payments happen here.
terms.s1Body: Opening hours, availability and pass conditions may change. The gym itself is the authoritative source — call to confirm.
terms.s2Body: We deliberately don't quote prices here. Prices are given at the desk.
rules: Re-rack your plates and dumbbells when you're done.
Wipe down benches and machines after use.
Return mats and collars to where they belong.
Respect other people's sets — share the equipment.
terms.riskBody: Training with weights carries inherent physical risk. You train at your own responsibility, and should consult a doctor if you're unsure.
terms.lawBody: Bulgarian law governs these terms. The Bulgarian text prevails over any translation.
